detail.descriptionHtml:
Product Name:

KPV (Lys-Pro-Val)

Chemical Information:
  • Molecular Formula: C16H30N4O4
  • Molecular Weight: 342.43 g/mol
  • Sequence: Lys-Pro-Val
  • Structure Class: Synthetic tripeptide
Molecular Structure:
Product Description:

KPV is a synthetic tripeptide consisting of lysine, proline, and valine. This compound is supplied as a lyophilized powder and is intended solely for in vitro laboratory research use by qualified professionals.

Research Applications:

KPV is currently used in controlled research settings to study topics including:

  • Characterization of peptide structural properties in vitro
  • Analysis of peptide stability and degradation profiles
  • Evaluation of physicochemical properties of short-chain peptide compounds
  • Investigation of peptide behavior under controlled laboratory conditions
  • Analytical assessment of peptide consistency and composition
Storage and Handling:
  • Store lyophilized powder at −20°C to −80°C
  • Once reconstituted, store at 2-8°C and use promptly
  • Use aseptic techniques during handling to preserve quality
Product Specifications:
  • Purity: ≥99% (HPLC Certified)
  • Appearance: White lyophilized powder
  • Solubility: Soluble in suitable laboratory agents
Compliance Notice:

KPV is FOR RESEARCH USE ONLY. It is not intended for human or veterinary use. This product has not been evaluated by the FDA. Misuse of this product is strictly prohibited and may violate federal, state, or local laws. By purchasing this product, buyer represents and warrants that it will be used only for in vitro research purposes.
